Class OffscreenWindows.ScreenEvent

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.script.OffscreenWindows.ScreenEvent
Enclosing class:
OffscreenWindows
public static final class OffscreenWindows.ScreenEvent extends Object
Screen-wide lifecycle, input and drawing context. Retained values are safe; drawing expires after dispatch.

    • clipped

      public void clipped(int x, int y, int width, int height, OffscreenWindows.ScreenHandler painter)
      Draws inside a GUI-space clip, intersected with the caller's existing scissor. Nested calls and callback failures restore the previous graphics state. The callback receives this same borrowed event and must not retain it.
      Parameters:
      x - viewport left in GUI units
      y - viewport top in GUI units
      width - viewport width, nonnegative
      height - viewport height, nonnegative
      painter - synchronous drawing callback; its boolean return is ignored
